law_name: Law No. 14 on Copyright of 28 December 1977, as amended by Decree-Law No. 156 of 1994
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years from 1 January of the year after death (Decree-Law 156 of 1994; originally 25 years); photographs 25 years
moral_rights: Moral rights recognized; perpetual, inalienable and imprescriptible
fair_use_exceptions: Non-profit libraries and archives may copy works from permanent collections to preserve or replace them; other exceptions not seen (unconfirmed)
enforcement_body: National Copyright Centre (CENDA; created by Decree 20 of 21 Feb 1978)
notes: Berne accession 20 Nov 1996, in force 20 Feb 1997 (excludes Art. 33(1) ICJ clause); not-party to WCT/WPPT inferred from absence in WIPO Lex country list; WTO membership from member lists; 2006 draft decree-law to update the regime, status unknown
